name: タスク開始
rule: qualification+binding+composition+grant+budget+deps -> committed intent -> durable receive -> native start; fail before commit means no external start

name: 結果から独立検証
rule: orthogonal outcome -> quiescence -> frozen snapshot -> separate verifier scope -> raw evidence -> signed receipts; UI cannot accept

name: 上流策定
rule: parallel research/experiments -> join actual evidence -> ADR/spec -> independent semantic review; omitted middle facts cannot justify acceptance

name: 停止と復旧
rule: close admission -> durable pause -> quiescence -> reconcile message/intent/effect -> current grant/baseline -> resume; audit replay has no side effect

name: 更新と再資格
rule: new binary/config/schema/source invalidates its dependent qualifications/projections/receipts; immutable old runs do not live-reload

invariant: qualified fixed model/effort and effective skills -> role/task context preserving complete hard requirements -> durable dispatch -> native-owned history -> independent proof and measured optimization
failure: no dispatch on missing mandatory context/invalid pack; no product acceptance on unexecuted model qualification

name: 文書から実行まで
rule: approved input/solution -> typed closure -> concise TaskPacket -> actual operation authorization -> durable intent -> scoped dispatch; graph text never grants authority

name: 変更・拒否・再ゲートと継続
rule: deny/hold/quarantine scoped -> preserve facts -> authorized correction -> impact invalidation -> same required requalification -> resume; independent work continues

name: 生成・資格・開始
rule: dotfiles canonical adh profile -> generated native configs -> effective probes -> pinned ReleaseSet -> TaskPacket -> durable dispatch; legacy express cannot satisfy product qualification

name: 根拠・設計・実装
rule: canonical required closure + ACL-scoped supplemental graph -> cited experiments/ADR/SPEC -> task packet -> implementation -> independent evidence; semantic candidates never authorize

name: 整形から証拠失効
rule: writer authorized fix -> new snapshot -> stale knowledge and receipts identified -> frozen check-only validation -> integration new receipt

name: 並列実装・統合
rule: disjoint worktrees -> independent quality and graph candidates -> single index publisher -> serialized ReleaseSet integration -> E2E

name: 知識停止から復旧
rule: graph unavailable -> exact canonical fallback if complete -> continue unrelated permitted tasks -> rebuild -> qualify; missing required source holds only its task

name: Hook不稼働・迂回
rule: absent/bypassed local hook -> protected independent inventory -> defect still found -> repair without disable-all

name: 学習と配布
rule: raw evidence -> candidate learning -> evaluation and authorized promotion -> new release -> no live policy swap

name: 最終RC受け入れ
rule: same two repository revisions + same scope + fixed checks + independent A3/A4 + operations restore -> single acceptance; NOT_RUN is never PASS
